environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 443 terminated at the instance via nginx. No additional middleware or filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The Flask app runs via gunicorn with 4 workers, accessed directly after TLS termination at nginx.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP mode, no inspection
config.proxy: nginx reverse_proxy to localhost:8080, no ModSecurity
